summary: Bounds-checked texture-layer entry updater (thiscall). Writes a multi-field payload into the entry at index a2 (stride (a2 << 7) within the this+0x34 array), sets the 0x1000 update/dirty bit on that entry, and clears the 0x10000 dirty-tracking bit on the parent at this+0x20. Returns the entry pointer, or the raw index when out of bounds.

operations.description: Bounds guard: only when index a2 < this[11] (element count at this+0x2C) is the entry update performed.
Seed the default result with the raw index: result = a2 (returned unchanged when the guard fails).

MultiFieldSetter(this[13] + (a2 << 7) + 16, a3, a4, a5) writes the multi-field payload into the texture-layer entry (this[13] is the array pointer at this+0x34; entry stride (a2 << 7) bytes, payload at +0x10).
Point result at the entry base: result = this[13] + (a2 << 7).
Set the 0x1000 update/dirty bit on the entry: *result |= 0x1000.
Clear the parent dirty-tracking bit 0x10000 at this+0x20: this[8] &= ~0x10000.
Return the entry pointer (the raw index a2 when out of bounds).

Called by ParticleCollisionSpark (0x004CB620), WheelRenderObjectPerFrameUpdate (0x004CB860), ParticleTrailEmitter (0x004CBC50) and ParticleInstanceUpdate (0x004CC1D0) to flag texture-layer entries dirty per frame.
